package main

import (
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"runtime/pprof"
	"time"

	_ "example.com/scaling/design"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/codegen/generator"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/eval"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/expr"
)

func main() {
	maxHeap := flag.Int("max-heap-mib", 768, "stop above this sampled Go heap size")
	timeout := flag.Duration("timeout", 45*time.Second, "stop after this elapsed duration")
	flag.Parse()
	if flag.NArg() != 1 || *maxHeap <= 0 || *timeout <= 0 {
		panic("provide positive limits and one allocation-profile path")
	}
	start := time.Now()
	go guard(start, uint64(*maxHeap)<<20, *timeout, flag.Arg(0)+".guard")
	if err := expr.RegisterDefaultRoots(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := eval.RunDSL(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	outputs, err := generator.Generate(".", "gen", "example.com/scaling/design", false)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var memory runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&memory)
	if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "MEASURE files=%d elapsed=%s total_alloc=%d heap_alloc=%d heap_inuse=%d num_gc=%d\n", len(outputs), time.Since(start), memory.TotalAlloc, memory.HeapAlloc, memory.HeapInuse, memory.NumGC); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	writeProfile(flag.Arg(0))
}

func guard(start time.Time, maxHeap uint64, timeout time.Duration, profile string) {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(50 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for range ticker.C {
		var memory runtime.MemStats
		runtime.ReadMemStats(&memory)
		if memory.HeapAlloc <= maxHeap && time.Since(start) <= timeout {
			continue
		}
		if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "GUARD elapsed=%s total_alloc=%d heap_alloc=%d num_gc=%d\n", time.Since(start), memory.TotalAlloc, memory.HeapAlloc, memory.NumGC); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		writeProfile(profile)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
}

func writeProfile(path string) {
	file, err := os.Create(path)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := pprof.Lookup("allocs").WriteTo(file, 0); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
